hook: Everything from Lessons 01 to 12 is one stage of one pipeline. This lesson is the scaffold that turns those stages into a single end-to-end run: tokenize, pre-train, scale, SFT, align, evaluate, quantize, serve. You will not train a 70B model on a laptop. You will produce the orchestration layer, the manifest, the eval gate, and the rollback plan that a 2026 frontier team uses to decide what gets shipped. This is the capstone.
